svg.title: Janus architecture: the agent loop
svg.desc: Flow of one page snapshot through observe, plan, ground, validate, authorize, escalate, execute, re-resolve, egress check, act and verify. The planner model is an untrusted proposer; deterministic validators and executor checks authorize and gate every step.
svg.text: One leg per page snapshot · the model proposes, deterministic code decides
reject: errors fed back to the planner, retry
Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Mermaid), every module path checked against src/janus/. A diagram of the design, not a performance claim.
